translationRepairs: Her son Ji was then less than ten days old; she reared him within the inner quarters and never once left the house.
Her son Ji was then less than one hundred days old; she reared him within the inner quarters and never once left the house.
旬 is a ten-day period, so 十旬 is one hundred days; 生未十旬 means Ji was not yet one hundred days old, and ‘ten days’ is a real mistranslation.
At that time her son Ji was not yet ten days old; she reared him within the inner chambers and never went out the door.
At that time her son Ji was not yet one hundred days old; she reared him within the inner chambers and never went out the door.
The same 未十旬 requires ‘not yet one hundred days old’ in the literal; ‘ten days’ undercounts by reading 旬 as a single day.

Though Zong was not a legitimate heir, her filial devotion overcame all bounds; though she failed to preserve her life, her resolve was fierce and her righteousness profound. Without special honor, how may we guide those adrift in shallow ways?

Though Zong was not a legitimate male heir, her filial devotion could not overcome her grief; though she departed from due moderation, her resolve was fierce and her righteousness profound. Without special honor, how may we guide those adrift in shallow ways?

孝不勝哀 means filial devotion could not overcome grief, so the before reverses that relation and must be fixed; but 乖俯就 is departure from mourning moderation (俯就), not ‘failed to preserve her life’, which the proposal still retains.
Lu then walked on foot with her aged mother-in-law to the Secretariat and reported the truth herself.
Lu then walked on foot with her aged mother-in-law to the Office of the Minister over the Masses and reported the truth herself.
司徒府 is the Situ’s office (Minister over the Masses/Education), not the Secretariat; the proposal’s ‘Minister of Works’ is 司空, so the office title still needs correction.
Lu then walked on foot with her aged mother-in-law to the Secretariat Director's office and reported the circumstances herself.
Lu then walked on foot with her aged mother-in-law to the Office of the Minister over the Masses and reported the circumstances herself.
Literal likewise misrenders 司徒府 as the Secretariat Director’s office; replacing it with Minister of Works still confuses 司徒 with 司空.
